about: Minimum and maximum sizes, timings and thresholds the page uses. Leave these alone unless the user points something out or the annoyance vector says so; if you must change one, change it here (or override it in your prefs/ui.json under "limits"), never in the code. The host reloads this file by itself. `arrive-pulse-ms`: how long a new card's soft glow lasts. `arrive-*`: a new card grows from `arrive-from` of its size on a damped spring (lower damping = more overshoot). `base-scale` / `medium-scale` / `large-scale`: the size a card shows at by its chip size (none or chip / medium / large); cards never scale on hover (user, 11-11). `arrive-wide` / `arrive-long`: a card this many times wider than tall unfolds left to right, this many times taller than wide unrolls top to bottom (else it grows from its centre). `row-stagger-ms` / `row-start-ms`: list, checklist, paste and ask rows come in one after another. Key + detail (user, 11-11): a card with more to show starts folded (a pie shows its ring, a list its first rows, a long card its top) and hovering opens the rest WITHOUT any zoom change: `hover-delay-ms` before it opens, `shrink-delay-ms` before it folds back, `reveal-ms` how long the slide takes, `compact-if-taller` the natural height past which any card folds. `chart-key-frac`: a folded line / bar chart is drawn at this share of its width and widens on hover. `text-heavy-chars`: a card with no size named and more text than this (and no chart) is a medium card.
